workflow.name: Gold Star Flag Football Operations
workflow.description: End-to-end operational workflow for Gold Star Flag Football, managed by Eagle Eye Vision Labz (EEVL). Covers tryout campaigns, player registrations, game day event coverage, and end-of-season reporting.

tasks.name: Tryout Campaign
tasks.description: Generate tryout flyers, schedule social media campaigns, blast SMS/email to past registrants, set up targeted ads, and create registration pages for upcoming seasons.

tasks.name: Registrations
tasks.description: Process GHL form submissions, auto-tag leads, create ClickUp tasks, populate Airtable rosters, send welcome messages, handle Stripe payments, and assign players to teams.

tasks.name: Event Coverage
tasks.description: Generate game day shoot checklists, hand off media to Sparrow via the #gold-star Lark channel, produce highlight reels, manage photo packages, and set up parent galleries.

tasks.name: Season Report
tasks.description: Aggregate player stats and standings from Airtable, generate PDF reports for parents, compile season highlights, nominate awards, and promote next season early registration.

seasonal.description: Quarterly trigger on the 1st of January, April, July, and October at 9:00 AM UTC to kick off tryout campaigns for upcoming seasons.

ghl_form.description: Triggered in real-time when a new player registration form is submitted through GoHighLevel.

manual.description: Trigger any task on-demand for ad-hoc operations such as mid-season roster changes, makeup game coverage, or emergency communications.

ghl.name: GoHighLevel MCP
ghl.description: CRM operations including form processing, SMS/email blasts, lead auto-tagging, pipeline management, and registration page creation for Gold Star Flag Football.

airtable.name: Airtable MCP
airtable.description: Roster management, player stats tracking, team standings, attendance records, and season data aggregation.

clickup.name: ClickUp MCP
clickup.description: Task creation for registrant processing, game day shoot checklists, and operational task tracking.

lark.name: Lark MCP
lark.description: Team notifications via the #gold-star channel, Sparrow media handoff coordination, and internal communications.

google_drive.name: Google Drive MCP
google_drive.description: Media asset storage, photo gallery hosting, flyer archiving, and report distribution for Gold Star Flag Football.

stripe.name: Stripe MCP
stripe.description: Registration payment processing, fee collection, refund handling, and payment status tracking.
